CustomField.description: Display name: the Contact's name when linked, otherwise the typed first/last. (Built from FirstName/LastName components — the compound Name isn't formula-accessible through a lookup.) Gala Event Gifts / Jason Ott.
CustomField.formula: IF( NOT(ISBLANK(Contact__c)), TRIM(BLANKVALUE(Contact__r.FirstName, "") & " " & Contact__r.LastName), TRIM(BLANKVALUE(First_Name__c, "") & " " & BLANKVALUE(Last_Name__c, "")) )
CustomField.label: Guest Name
